Class Abilities

1st Level

Spellcasting (Intelligence)

  • Effect: Vancian slot-based casting per the Spellblade Spells Per Day table below, from a narrower Spellblade spell list focused on self-buffs, melee-enhancing effects, and direct-damage spells rather than Wizard's full utility breadth.
  • DC = 10 + half your Spellblade level (minimum 1) + Intelligence modifier: see Spellcasting in Arneyan for the full formula.
  • Harmful or debuffing spells need a save, except Touch spells, which use a touch attack (see Spellcasting in Arneyan).

Spellstrike

  • Effect: As part of a normal weapon attack with your bonded weapon type, you may deliver a spell through the strike.
  • The attack roll is a normal weapon attack (vs AC, your own BtH: not a spell attack roll).
  • If the attack hits, the spell's effect triggers on the same target immediately, resolving however that spell normally would (automatic, or a save against your Spellblade DC).
  • No separate action is spent.
  • You may Spellstrike once per round; if the attack misses, the spell is lost and any slot spent on it is expended.
  • Cantrip Spellstrike: at-will, no slot cost.
  • Deals 1d4 force damage through the strike (2d4 at 5th level, 3d4 at 11th, 4d4 at 17th, 5d4 at 21st).
  • From 7th level your Extra Attack can carry a Cantrip Spellstrike too, a second one that round.
  • This is what you do most rounds — it keeps Spellblade doing something better than a bare weapon hit without burning resources.
  • Levelled Spellstrike: from 3rd level, expend a prepared spell slot to deliver that spell's full effect through the strike instead.
  • The strike also deals bonus damage of the spell's damage type (force if it has none): +1d6 for a 1st- or 2nd-level spell, +2d6 for a 3rd- or 4th-level spell.
  • This is the nova option — limited per day, meant for the rounds that matter.
  • Eligible spells: Spellstrike delivers only a spell that targets a single creature (a touch, a ray or one target at range).
  • Area spells, self-only spells and spells with several targets cannot be delivered.
  • The target makes any save as normal.
  • On a critical hit, only the weapon's own dice add their maximum (see Critical Hits & Critical Fails in The Arneyan Codex); the spell and the Spellstrike bonus dice are rolled normally.
  • A spell held over by First Cut uses that round's Spellstrike.

Arcane Cascade

  • Effect: After a Spellstrike (cantrip or levelled) that hits, the first attack against you before your next turn has Disadvantage: the backwash of channelling a spell through a weapon rather than letting it go cleanly keeps your guard up.
  • 9th level: the first two attacks against you before your next turn have Disadvantage

4th Level

War Magic

  • Effect: When you cast a cantrip as your action, you may make one weapon attack with your bonded weapon type immediately afterwards.

5th Level

Everstrike

  • Effect: Once per day, your next Levelled Spellstrike of 2nd level or lower costs no slot.
  • 13th level: a spell of 4th level or lower
  • 19th level: a spell of any level

7th Level

Extra Attack

  • Effect: When you use your action to attack, make one additional attack with your bonded weapon type as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex). Spellstrike may be delivered through either attack, still once per round.

15th Level

Intelligence Bonus: permanent +1 Intelligence

20th Level

Renown: Order of the Blade

  • Effect: You may found a school of spellblades (see Renown in The Arneyan Codex); each season 1d4 students (1st-level Spellblades) join it. While you hold it, you may change your bonded weapon type during a rest.

24th Level

  • Everstrike improves: twice per day, and one Spellstrike may deliver two different prepared spells through the same hit.

Feats of Arneyan

  • As a hybrid class (like Bard, Paladin, Ranger, Gunslinger, Swashbuckler and Artificer), the Spellblade may choose from either Martial Path or Arcane & Devout Path at any Feat level without needing to multiclass. A Spellblade with the Shadow Edge kit may also choose from the Specialist Path.

Kits and Path: Spellblade Traditions

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Spellblade folder. Drag one onto your character.

Choose one Kit at character creation (Bladebound, Shadow Edge, Wardblade or Driftblade), or the Battle Caster Path in its place. All share the Spellstrike and Arcane Cascade baseline above. A kit improves at 9th level; the Path grows at 5th and 10th.

Spellblade Spells Per Day

  • Slots follow the Sorcerer's table two rows behind (a 7th-level Spellblade has the slots of a 5th-level Sorcerer), up to the maximum spell level of 4th.
  • A Spellblade has no spell slots at 1st and 2nd level, only cantrips and Cantrip Spellstrike.
  • Cantrips are cast at will.
  • Bonus spells from high Intelligence apply once the Spellblade is high enough level to cast that tier.

Spellblade Spell List

Spells available to the Spellblade, by level. * = reversible spell.

  • Full descriptions, saves and components are in Spellcasting in Arneyan.
  • Includes every Wizard-list spell of the Spellblade’s favoured schools (Evocation and Abjuration), up to the highest spell level the Spellblade can cast, except Stoneskin and Melf's Minute Meteors.

0 Level (Cantrips)

Arcane Mark · Dancing Lights · Detect Magic · Detect Poison · Endure Elements · Fire Bolt · Light · Mending · Ray of Frost · Resistance

1st Level

Alarm · Burning Hands · Feather Fall · Hold Portal · Jump · Mage Armour · Magic Missile · Protection from Alignment · Shield · Shocking Grasp · Spider Climb · Tenser's Floating Disc · Thunderwave

2nd Level

Continual Flame‡ · Darkness* · Enhance Attribute* · Hold Person · Invisibility · Levitate · Melf's Acid Arrow · Mirror Image · Ray of Enfeeblement · Scorching Ray · See Invisibility · Shatter

3rd Level

Blink · Counterspell · Dispel Magic · Explosive Runes · Fireball · Fly · Gust of Wind · Haste (self only) · Leomund's Tiny Hut · Lightning Bolt · Magic Circle vs Alignment‡ · Nondetection‡ · Protection from Normal Missiles

4th Level
